source_note: Facts cross-checked against the app's question bank and standard references.

bullets.en: Nepali belongs to the Indo-European family, Indo-Aryan branch.
bullets.ne: नेपाली भाषा भारोपेली परिवार, इन्डो-आर्यन शाखाकी हुन्।

bullets.en: Dashain: 15 days, Bijaya Dashami the main day. Tihar: 5 days; Laxmi Puja on day 3 (Oct–Nov).
bullets.ne: दशैँ: 15 दिन, विजया दशमी मुख्य दिन। तिहार: 5 दिन; लक्ष्मी पूजा तेस्रो दिन (अक्टोबर–नोभेम्बर)।

bullets.en: Sakela dance: performed by the Rai community during Ubhauli and Udhauli.
bullets.ne: साकेला नाच: राई समुदायले उभौली र उधौलीमा नाच्छन्।

bullets.en: Madan Puraskar (est. 1955): 2068/2012 — सेतो धर्ती by अमर न्यौपाने।
bullets.ne: मदन पुरस्कार (स्थापना 1955): 2068/2012 — सेतो धर्ती, अमर न्यौपाने।

bullets.en: The first Nepali movie: Aama (1964 / 2021 BS).
National symbols: cow (animal), danphe (bird), rhododendron/laliguras (flower), crimson and blue (colours).
bullets.ne: राष्ट्रिय चिह्न: गाई (जनावर), डाँफे (पक्षी), लालीगुराँस (फूल), सिम्रिक र निलो (रङ)।

bullets.en: Nepal is socially diverse: 120+ caste/ethnic groups and 120+ languages.
bullets.ne: नेपाल सामाजिक रूपमा विविध: 120+ जातजाति र 120+ भाषा।

bullets.en: ASEAN has 11 member states (Timor-Leste joined in 2025).
